rules.reason: Agent feedback changes affect the shared quality evidence contract and local-control-plane boundary.
followups: Confirm the quality surface remains metadata-only and read-only; WordPress approval, preflight, and final writes stay local.

rules.reason: Editor-assist quality changes affect regression evidence, automatic detection, and no-auto-mutation guarantees.
followups: Treat AI-generated issue candidates as read-only evidence; do not authorize automatic prompt, model, router, approval, or WordPress mutations.

rules.reason: Agent/workflow metadata is a shared read-only projection contract and must not become execution or approval truth.
followups: Verify the projection remains display/detail truth only, with no workflow execution, approval, prompt, preset, MCP, OpenClaw, or WordPress-write ownership.

rules.reason: Runtime stability policy governs shared architecture and infrastructure expansion boundaries.
followups: Keep FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, worker, and Docker Compose as the default stack unless measured evidence satisfies the documented sidecar gate.

rules.reason: Cloud boundary changes can move control-plane or truth ownership and require anti-drift evidence.
followups: Confirm local ability, workflow, approval, prompt/router/preset, audit, and final-write truth remain outside Cloud.

rules.reason: Admin route work changes operator composition or interaction and requires the governed Admin gate.
followups: Run the focused target-route PC browser gate; add pnpm run check:admin-ui:visual once at closeout for material layout, table, dialog, or shared-primitive changes.

rules.reason: Shared Admin primitives and the Admin manifest have multi-route blast radius.
followups: Treat shared primitive changes as L2 and run pnpm run check:admin-ui:visual once at closeout after the focused PC browser check.

rules.reason: The changed-file router, validation rules, and CI selection are shared engineering policy interfaces.
followups: GitHub Actions is the runtime for this CI/tooling change; do not dispatch M4 unless Cloud runtime inputs also changed.
